Black Marble tiles covering an area of interest

Source: R/tiles.R
ntl_tiles.Rd

Black Marble products are distributed on a fixed 10 x 10 degree longitude/latitude grid with 36 horizontal (h00-h35) and 18 vertical (v00-v17) tiles. Tile hHHvVV spans longitude -180 + 10 * HH to -170 + 10 * HH and latitude 90 - 10 * VV down to 80 - 10 * VV.

Usage

ntl_tiles(aoi, refine = TRUE)

Arguments

aoi

Area of interest: an sf/sfc object, a terra SpatVector, or a numeric bounding box c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) in degrees.

refine

If TRUE (default), keep only tiles that intersect the geometry itself, not just its bounding box.

Value

A data frame with columns tile, h, v, xmin, xmax, ymin and ymax.

Examples

# Bounding box of Kazakhstan
ntl_tiles(c(46.4, 40.5, 87.4, 55.5))
#>      tile  h v xmin xmax ymin ymax
#> 1  h22v03 22 3   40   50   50   60
#> 2  h23v03 23 3   50   60   50   60
#> 3  h24v03 24 3   60   70   50   60
#> 4  h25v03 25 3   70   80   50   60
#> 5  h26v03 26 3   80   90   50   60
#> 6  h22v04 22 4   40   50   40   50
#> 7  h23v04 23 4   50   60   40   50
#> 8  h24v04 24 4   60   70   40   50
#> 9  h25v04 25 4   70   80   40   50
#> 10 h26v04 26 4   80   90   40   50
